# Scalvea

> Science-backed hair and scalp care, formulated with clinically researched ingredients. Operating in Australia and India.

## Products
- [Follicle 8 Hair Growth Serum](https://scalvea.com/product/follicle-8-hair-growth-serum): Clinically inspired hair growth serum powered by 4% Anagain, 3% Redensyl, 3% Baicapil, and 3% Procapil to nourish follicles and reduce excessive shedding.
- [Scalp-5 Anti-Dandruff Hair Serum](https://scalvea.com/product/scalp-5-anti-dandruff-hair-serum): Anti-dandruff treatment with Salicylic Acid, Piroctone Olamine, Zinc PCA, and Tea Tree Extract to reduce visible flakes, soothe irritation, and restore scalp comfort.
